channel.description: Latest articles from The Christian Post (christianpost.com)

item.title: Huckabee responds after Jerusalem church leaders claim Christian Zionism is a 'damaging ideology'
item.description: U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee has criticized Orthodox church leaders in Jerusalem for disparaging "free-church believers" by claiming in a joint statement that Christian Zionism is a “damaging ideology” that threatens the unity of the Christian community in the Holy Land and undermines the authority of the historic apostolic churches. #Christianity #Zionism #Jerusalem

item.title: Oklahoma man charged with threatening to kill ICE agents, Trump supporters
item.description: An Oklahoma man has been charged with posting threats online against U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents, as well as Republican supporters of President Donald Trump. #Prigmore #ICEagents #Trump #MAGA #threats #SecondAmendment #FBI

item.title: Pornhub conspired to make porn addiction recovery advocate's life 'living nightmare': lawsuit
item.description: Pornhub’s parent company allegedly instigated a retaliation campaign to discredit the founder of a website that helps people struggling with porn addiction, according to a recent lawsuit. #Aylo #pornographyaddiction #RICO #disinformation #addictionrecovery

item.title: Potential Democrat presidential contender agrees that men can't become women
item.description: Only one of nearly 20 Democratic presidential hopefuls agreed that men cannot become women, as the Democratic Party's position appears to stand at odds with public opinion on some issues related to gender and sexuality. #2028presidentialelection #RahmEmanuel #JoshShapiro #LGBT #Transgender #PeteButtigieg

item.title: Historian Yuval Harari warns AI will take over religion, law and jobs
item.description: It could happen in the next two years or the next decade but artificial intelligence is already so advanced and deeply entrenched in society, renowned historian Yuval Noah Harari believes anything made of words such as religions like Christianity and Judaism will be taken over by AI. #Historian #YuvalHarari #AI #Religion

item.title: Abortion, gay marriage: 4 constitutional amendments approved by Virginia Legislature
item.description: Here are four proposed constitutional amendments approved by the Virginia Legislature reflecting an unabashedly progressive agenda that voters will weigh in on later this year. #Abortion #Samesexmarriage #Virginia #2026election

item.title: US Senate hopeful James Talarico: All religions have 'same truth' as Christianity
item.description: After claiming on a recent podcast that America is “not a Christian nation,” Texas Democratic lawmaker and U.S. Senate hopeful James Talarico said all religions contain the "same truth" as Christianity. #Texas #JamesTalarico #Christianity

item.title: Jelly Roll breaks down, shares Gospel message live on Netflix’s ‘Star Search’: 'Jesus is for everybody'
item.description: The Gospel message of redemption and grace took center stage on “Star Search” Tuesday night when contestant Bear Bailey performed “Hard Fought Hallelujah,” transforming a live Netflix competition into an explicit proclamation of faith. #StarSearch #Netflix #JellyRoll #BearBailey #HardFoughtHallelujah

item.title: Dallas Baptist University evacuated amid threats ahead of speech by Trump's HUD chief Scott Turner
item.description: Dallas Baptist University canceled classes Thursday amid concerns about an unspecified threat to campus ahead of a planned speech by President Donald Trump's Housing and Urban Development Secretary Scott Turner. #DallasBaptistUniversity #evacuation #Trump #ScottTurner

item.title: Cities Church anti-ICE protesters arrested, charged with FACE Act violations
item.description: The U.S. Department of Justice announced Thursday that federal agents arrested three activists involved in an anti-ICE protest that disrupted a worship service last Sunday at Cities Church in St. Paul, Minnesota. #CitiesChurch #FBI #PamBondi #NekimaLevyArmstrong #ChauntyllLouisaAllen
